invariants.text: Admission of foreign evidence transfers no Resolution Authority and authorizes no effect.
Every admitted import is exactly bound to a target-local Seed binding and begins fail-closed as UNKNOWN with enforcement BLOCKED.
The Network core owns no terminal recognition state; terminal ALLOW or BLOCK remains exclusively target-local Seed state.
Every accepted admission appends exactly one immutable evidence-history digest; history itself confers no Authority.
An exact admission replay is idempotent and conflicting reuse of an ImportID is rejected.
The Network core may strengthen but may not weaken or supersede pinned Seed semantics.

defines: exact projection of an admitted import to a target-local Seed ResolutionBinding

principles.text: Foreign evidence may cross a Context boundary; recognition does not.
Admission registers target-local evidence; it is not authorization.
Only an exact target-local Seed resolution may create terminal recognition.
Federation, routing and transport are optional profiles over the minimal admission core.

requirements.text: Implementations MUST expose deterministic observable results for every core conformance case.
Implementations MUST treat ImportObservation as immutable content-addressed evidence and MUST reject conflicting ImportID reuse.
Every admitted ImportObservation MUST project exactly to a target-local Seed ResolutionBinding and MUST begin UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
Implementations MUST NOT represent terminal recognition as Network-owned canonical state.
Implementations MUST preserve provenance to the admitted evidence digest and MUST publish operational security and durability guarantees separately.
Core conformance MUST NOT require federation, routing, transport, liveness or dynamic-profile activation claims.

state.history: canonical append-only accepted-admission evidence digest sequence

state_partition.transition_enabling_rule: Evidence history MUST NOT itself confer Authority or alter admission eligibility.
